subject.title: [优化建议] 添加结构化错误处理和智能重试机制

question: What npm installer error policy should OpenClaw ship for retries, auto-repair, and fail-closed behavior across POSIX, Windows, install-cli, and Docker setup?
rationale: The remaining work can improve setup UX, but retrying, auto-repairing, or changing best-effort probes affects upgrade compatibility and security-sensitive npm failure handling.

options.title: Conservative diagnostics plus transient retries
options.body: Retry only clearly transient network errors, keep security and local-system failures fail-fast with actionable remediation, and avoid changing best-effort probes without explicit cases.

options.title: Broader automatic remediation
options.body: Attempt permission and cleanup repairs automatically after classification, accepting more installer-side mutation and a larger compatibility/security review burden.

options.title: Diagnostics only
options.body: Standardize structured error messages without adding retry or auto-repair behavior, leaving recovery to the user or doctor flows.

recommendation.title: Conservative diagnostics plus transient retries
recommendation.body: Retry only clearly transient network errors, keep security and local-system failures fail-fast with actionable remediation, and avoid changing best-effort probes without explicit cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-history signal for the installer and Docker setup files is recent work by @vincentkoc across the affected surfaces.
